hook: Bell moved from theoretical chemistry research at Berkeley and Caltech into technology leadership at Uber, then led data science and AI organizations across four different industries, energy at bp, automotive at Ford, and now retail at The Home Depot, one of the few executives to have run enterprise AI at that scale in more than one sector.
name: Franziska Bell

quote.text: Deeply passionate about delivering best-in-class user experiences, partnering with colleagues to drive business impact at scale and sharing my experience from global tech executive roles in four industry sectors spanning Tech, Automotive, Energy, and Retail.
quote.context: Franziska Bell, PhD, personal LinkedIn profile summary

moniker: CTO of The Home Depot, Four-Industry Technology Executive

timeline.event: Completes PhD at UC Berkeley; joins Caltech as a postdoctoral scholar
timeline.impact: Builds foundation in high-performance computing and applied mathematics

timeline.event: Joins Uber as a Data Scientist, rising to Director of Data Science
timeline.impact: Moves from academic research into large-scale AI platform leadership

timeline.event: Named Chief Data, AI and Analytics Officer at Ford
timeline.impact: Leads AI strategy at a major automaker

timeline.event: Named EVP and CTO of The Home Depot
timeline.impact: Brings four-industry AI leadership to retail

quick_facts: EVP and Chief Technology Officer of The Home Depot
Previously Chief Data, AI and Analytics Officer at Ford Motor Company and Group CTO at bp
Holds a PhD in Theoretical Chemistry from UC Berkeley and was a postdoctoral scholar at Caltech
Named to Reuters' Trailblazing Women in Enterprise AI 2026 and Top 100 Women in Tech

achievements.title: EVP and Chief Technology Officer, The Home Depot (2026-present)
achievements.impact: Leads technology strategy at one of the largest home improvement retailers, following a career spanning tech, automotive, energy, and retail.

achievements.title: Chief Data, AI and Analytics Officer, Ford Motor Company
achievements.impact: Led product, design, software engineering, data engineering, and AI teams driving user experience and business value across Ford.

achievements.title: Group Chief Technology Officer, bp
achievements.impact: Led a 4,000+ person organization spanning software engineering, data science, AI, and analytics across bp's global business, from B2C and B2B to energy production and trading.

achievements.title: Director of Data Science, Uber
achievements.impact: Led data science across seven major divisions and six global locations, partnering with over 1,400 engineers on AI, forecasting, and behavioral science platforms.

achievements.title: PhD research in theoretical chemistry, UC Berkeley and Caltech
achievements.impact: Published research on quantum molecular dynamics and singlet fission, recognized with the American Physical Society New Investigator Award.
